text: The sea wasn't always like this.
Too many things changed after the infection. Fishwalkers have appeared near the docks.
I figured as much. 'Tis safer 'round here now. Here, take this.
I heard some noises coming from the sunken ship. Can ya check it for me?
Using diving equipment enhances your super attack. Each piece you find increases the number of crosses and the speed of the aiming game. Find all three!
The fishwalkers are terrorizing us. If you kill 10 of them, I will reward you.
You have killed K monsters. Come back when you reach 10.
Thank you! Here is your reward.
I need a Herbal Decoction. Can you bring me one?
Thank you! Here is your reward.
You don't have a Herbal Decoction. Find one and come back.
I feel terrible... Please, I need an antidote.
Thank you! You saved my life. Take this.
I don't have an antidote... I'm doomed.
Help me! I've seen monsters. Kill 15 of them and I'll reward you.
You did it! Here's a helmet.
